items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 30:1
items.html: Because the hairs are also divided into the MTL like the inner vessels, and the aspect of the Mem of the hairs went out above, over the Galgalta, which is the aspect of the Mem of the inner vessels, and the aspect of the LTz of the hairs came out in the aspect of the hairs of the beard, in the illumination of the Mocha Stima'ah, which is the aspect of the Tzadi of the inner vessels. And see above, page 1000, answer 20.
